headline: Google further buries search results under AI mode
summary: Google's AI search summaries are now automatically expanding. This change pushes traditional search links much farther down the page. Users will see AI Overviews more prominently than classic results.

headline: Xbox CEO calls Project Helix a 'family of devices'
summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma clarified Project Helix's scope. It will be a 'family of devices,' not a single console. This hints at multiple next-gen Xbox hardware options.

headline: Save hundreds on a TCL mini-LED TV with quantum dots and high refresh rate
summary: TCL QM7L mini-LED TV is on sale at Amazon and Best Buy. Get up to $200 off, with the 55-inch model now $797.99. Offers quantum dots, high refresh rate, and competitive pricing against OLEDs.

headline: Trump's EPA wants to let data centers hide their air pollution
summary: EPA plans to remove a rule requiring public notice for industrial pollution permits. This change would allow data centers to conceal their air pollution. Communities will have less input on local data center emissions.

headline: The Pokémon Company Looks to Smart Device Integrations as Future Targets
summary: The Pokémon Company eyes future integration with smart devices. CEO Tsunekazu Ishihara hinted at plans during PokémonXP. Wearable technology could be a key focus for future Pokémon products.

headline: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil on Track to Have Biggest Opening Weekend of Any RE Movie in History
summary: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil film is set for a record-breaking opening. It's projected to be the most profitable RE movie debut ever. The adaptation of Capcom's horror franchise is a box office hit.

headline: Xbox CEO Says Project Helix Includes a 'Family of Devices'
summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirmed Project Helix is a 'family of devices.' This indicates Microsoft is developing multiple next-gen hardware options. The next Xbox generation won't be a single console.

headline: The Founders of Hooters Are Making a Buddy-Comedy Movie About the Restaurant Chain's Origin Story
summary: A Hooters origin story movie is in early pre-production. It's slated as a buddy-comedy film. The restaurant chain's original founders are directly involved.

headline: 97-year-old woman rescued after Nepali floods looked like 'a warrior'
summary: A 97-year-old woman, Guna Maya Bohara, survived flash floods in Nepal. She was rescued heroically using an excavator. Witnesses described her resilience as 'a warrior'.

headline: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
summary: Dramatic footage of deadly Tibet floods is suppressed in China. Little public information is available on victims or scale of damage. The lack of transparency limits understanding of the disaster.

headline: Man dies and at least six injured after sign falls at Christian festival
summary: A man died after a large sign collapsed at the Big Church Festival. Six others were injured in the incident near Steyning, West Sussex. Police are investigating the tragic accident at the Christian event.

headline: Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy
summary: A former landlady spoke out about her 9/11 hijacker tenants. She revealed their connections to an alleged Saudi spy. Her testimony, given to the BBC, marks her first public statement.
